params.name: ACRO_BAL_PITCH
params.desc_en: rate at which pitch angle returns to level in acro and sport mode. A higher value causes the vehicle to return to level faster. For helicopter sets the decay rate of the virtual flybar in the pitch axis. A higher value causes faster decay of desired to actual attitude.

params.name: ACRO_BAL_ROLL
params.desc_en: rate at which roll angle returns to level in acro and sport mode. A higher value causes the vehicle to return to level faster. For helicopter sets the decay rate of the virtual flybar in the roll axis. A higher value causes faster decay of desired to actual attitude.

params.name: ACRO_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: A range of options that can be applied to change acro mode behaviour. Air-mode enables ATC_THR_MIX_MAN at all times (air-mode has no effect on helicopters). Rate Loop Only disables the use of angle stabilization and uses angular rate stabilization only.

params.name: ACRO_RP_EXPO
params.desc_en: Acro roll/pitch Expo to allow faster rotation when stick at edges

params.name: ACRO_RP_RATE
params.desc_en: Acro mode maximum roll and pitch rate. Higher values mean faster rate of rotation

params.name: ACRO_RP_RATE_TC
params.display: Acro roll/pitch rate control input time constant
params.desc_en: Acro roll and pitch rate control input time constant. Low numbers lead to sharper response, higher numbers to softer response

params.name: ACRO_THR_MID
params.desc_en: Acro Throttle Mid

params.name: ACRO_TRAINER
params.desc_en: Type of trainer used in acro mode

params.name: ACRO_Y_EXPO
params.desc_en: Acro yaw expo to allow faster rotation when stick at edges

params.name: ACRO_Y_RATE
params.desc_en: Acro mode maximum yaw rate. Higher value means faster rate of rotation

params.name: ACRO_Y_RATE_TC
params.display: Acro yaw rate control input time constant
params.desc_en: Acro yaw rate control input time constant. Low numbers lead to sharper response, higher numbers to softer response

params.name: ADSB_EMIT_TYPE
params.desc_en: ADSB classification for the type of vehicle emitting the transponder signal. Default value is 14 (UAV).

params.name: ADSB_ICAO_ID
params.desc_en: ICAO_ID unique vehicle identification number of this aircraft. This is an integer limited to 24bits. If set to 0 then one will be randomly generated. If set to -1 then static information is not sent, transceiver is assumed pre-programmed.

params.name: ADSB_ICAO_SPECL
params.desc_en: ICAO_ID of special vehicle that ignores ADSB_LIST_RADIUS and ADSB_LIST_ALT. The vehicle is always tracked. Use 0 to disable.

params.name: ADSB_LEN_WIDTH
params.desc_en: Aircraft length and width dimension options in Length and Width in meters. In most cases, use a value of 1 for smallest size.

params.name: ADSB_LIST_ALT
params.desc_en: ADSB vehicle list altitude filter. Vehicles detected more than this altitude above our own altitude will be completely ignored. They will not show up in the SRx_ADSB stream to the GCS and will not be considered in any avoidance calculations. A value of 0 will disable this filter.

params.name: ADSB_LIST_MAX
params.desc_en: ADSB list size of nearest vehicles. Longer lists take longer to refresh with lower SRx_ADSB values.

params.name: ADSB_LIST_RADIUS
params.desc_en: ADSB vehicle list radius filter. Vehicles detected outside this radius will be completely ignored. They will not show up in the SRx_ADSB stream to the GCS and will not be considered in any avoidance calculations. A value of 0 will disable this filter.

params.name: ADSB_LOG
params.desc_en: 0: no logging, 1: log only special ID, 2:log all

params.name: ADSB_OFFSET_LAT
params.desc_en: GPS antenna lateral offset. This describes the physical location offset from center of the GPS antenna on the aircraft.

params.name: ADSB_OFFSET_LON
params.desc_en: GPS antenna longitudinal offset. This is usually set to 1, Applied By Sensor

params.name: ADSB_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: Options for emergency failsafe codes and device capabilities

bitmask.en: Transmit in traditional Mode 3A/C only and inhibit Mode-S and ES (ADSB) transmissions

params.name: ADSB_RF_CAPABLE
params.desc_en: Describes your hardware RF In/Out capabilities.

params.name: ADSB_RF_SELECT
params.desc_en: Transceiver RF selection for Rx enable and/or Tx enable. This only effects devices that can Tx and/or Rx. Rx-only devices should override this to always be Rx-only.

params.name: ADSB_SQUAWK
params.desc_en: VFR squawk (Mode 3/A) code is a pre-programmed default code when the pilot is flying VFR and not in contact with ATC. In the USA, the VFR squawk code is octal 1200 (hex 0x280, decimal 640) and in most parts of Europe the VFR squawk code is octal 7000. If an invalid octal number is set then it will be reset to 1200.

params.name: ADSB_TYPE
params.desc_en: Type of ADS-B hardware for ADSB-in and ADSB-out configuration and operation. If any type is selected then MAVLink based ADSB-in messages will always be enabled

params.name: AEROM_ALT_ABORT
params.desc_en: Maximum allowable loss in altitude during a trick or sequence from its starting altitude.

params.name: AEROM_ANG_ACCEL
params.desc_en: Maximum angular acceleration in maneuvers

params.name: AEROM_ANG_TC
params.desc_en: This is the time over which we filter the desired roll to smooth it

params.name: AEROM_BOX_WIDTH
params.desc_en: Length of aerobatic "box"

params.name: AEROM_DEBUG
params.desc_en: This controls the printing of extra debug information on paths

params.name: AEROM_ENTRY_RATE
params.display: The roll rate to use when entering a roll maneuver
params.desc_en: This controls how rapidly we roll into a new orientation

params.name: AEROM_ERR_COR_D
params.display: D gain for path error corrections
params.desc_en: This controls how rapidly we correct back onto the desired path

params.name: AEROM_ERR_COR_P
params.display: P gain for path error corrections
params.desc_en: This controls how rapidly we correct back onto the desired path

params.name: AEROM_KE_RUDD
params.desc_en: Percent of rudder normally uses to sustain knife-edge at trick speed

params.name: AEROM_KE_RUDD_LK
params.desc_en: Time to look ahead in the path to calculate rudder correction for bank angle

params.name: AEROM_LKAHD
params.desc_en: This is how much time to look ahead in the path for calculating path rates

params.name: AEROM_MIS_ANGLE
params.desc_en: When set to a non-zero value, this is the assumed direction of the mission. Otherwise the waypoint angle is used

params.name: AEROM_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: Options to control aerobatic behavior

params.name: AEROM_PATH_SCALE
params.desc_en: Scale factor for Path/Box size. 0.5 would half the distances in maneuvers. Radii are unaffected.

params.name: AEROM_ROL_COR_TC
params.desc_en: This is the time constant for correcting roll errors. A smaller value leads to faster roll corrections

params.name: AEROM_SPD_I
params.desc_en: This controls how rapidly the throttle is raised to compensate for a speed error

params.name: AEROM_SPD_P
params.desc_en: This controls how rapidly the throttle is raised to compensate for a speed error

params.name: AEROM_STALL_PIT
params.desc_en: Pitch threashold for moving to final stage of stall turn

params.name: AEROM_STALL_THR
params.desc_en: Amount of throttle to reduce to for a stall turn

params.name: AEROM_THR_BOOST
params.desc_en: This is the extra throttle added in schedule elements marked as needing a throttle boost

params.name: AEROM_THR_LKAHD
params.desc_en: This controls how far ahead we look in time along the path for the target throttle

params.name: AEROM_THR_MIN
params.desc_en: Lowest throttle used during maneuvers

params.name: AEROM_THR_PIT_FF
params.desc_en: This controls how much extra throttle to add based on pitch ange. The value is for 90 degrees and is applied in proportion to pitch

params.name: AEROM_TIME_COR_P
params.display: Time constant for correction of our distance along the path
params.desc_en: This is the time constant for correcting path position errors

params.name: AEROM_TS_I
params.desc_en: This controls how rapidly two aircraft are brought back into time sync

params.name: AEROM_TS_P
params.desc_en: This controls how rapidly two aircraft are brought back into time sync

params.name: AEROM_TS_RATE
params.display: Timesync rate of send of NAMED_VALUE_FLOAT data
params.desc_en: This sets the rate we send data for time sync between aircraft

params.name: AEROM_TS_SPDMAX
params.desc_en: This sets the maximum speed adjustment for time sync between aircraft

params.name: AEROM_YAW_ACCEL
params.desc_en: This is maximum yaw acceleration to use

params.name: AFS_AMSL_ERR_GPS
params.display: Error margin for GPS based AMSL limit
params.desc_en: This sets margin for error in GPS derived altitude limit. This error margin is only used if the barometer has failed. If the barometer fails then the GPS will be used to enforce the AMSL_LIMIT, but this margin will be subtracted from the AMSL_LIMIT first, to ensure that even with the given amount of GPS altitude error the pressure altitude is not breached. OBC users should set this to comply with their D2 safety case. A value of -1 will mean that barometer failure will lead to immediate termination.

params.name: AFS_AMSL_LIMIT
params.desc_en: This sets the AMSL (above mean sea level) altitude limit. If the pressure altitude determined by QNH exceeds this limit then flight termination will be forced. Note that this limit is in meters, whereas pressure altitude limits are often quoted in feet. A value of zero disables the pressure altitude limit.

params.name: AFS_DUAL_LOSS
params.display: Enable dual loss terminate due to failure of both GCS and GPS simultaneously
params.desc_en: This enables the dual loss termination part of the AFS system. If this parameter is 1 and both GPS and the ground control station fail simultaneously, this will be considered a "dual loss" and cause termination.

params.name: AFS_ENABLE
params.desc_en: This enables the advanced failsafe system. If this is set to zero (disable) then all the other AFS options have no effect

params.name: AFS_GCS_TIMEOUT
params.desc_en: The time (in seconds) of persistent data link loss before GCS failsafe occurs.

params.name: AFS_GEOFENCE
params.desc_en: This enables the geofence part of the AFS. Will only be in effect if AFS_ENABLE is also 1

params.name: AFS_HB_PIN
params.desc_en: This sets a digital output pin which is cycled at 10Hz when termination is not activated. Note that if a FS_TERM_PIN is set then the heartbeat pin will continue to cycle at 10Hz when termination is activated, to allow the termination board to distinguish between autopilot crash and termination. Some common values are given, but see the Wiki's "GPIOs" page for how to determine the pin number for a given autopilot.

params.name: AFS_MAN_PIN
params.desc_en: This sets a digital output pin to set high when in manual mode. See the Wiki's "GPIOs" page for how to determine the pin number for a given autopilot.

params.name: AFS_MAX_COM_LOSS
params.display: Maximum number of comms loss events
params.desc_en: Maximum number of comms loss events before the aircraft stops returning to mission on comms recovery. Use zero to allow for any number of comms loss events.

params.name: AFS_MAX_GPS_LOSS
params.display: Maximum number of GPS loss events
params.desc_en: Maximum number of GPS loss events before the aircraft stops returning to mission on GPS recovery. Use zero to allow for any number of GPS loss events.

params.name: AFS_MAX_RANGE
params.desc_en: This is the maximum range of the vehicle in kilometers from first arming. If the vehicle goes beyond this range then the TERM_ACTION is performed. A value of zero disables this feature.

params.name: AFS_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: See description for each bitmask bit description

bitmask.en: Continue the mission even after comms are recovered (does not go to the mission item at the time comms were lost)
Enable AFS for all autonomous modes (not just AUTO)
Option to not jump to AFS_WP_COMMS if already in the return path

params.name: AFS_QNH_PRESSURE
params.desc_en: This sets the QNH pressure in millibars to be used for pressure altitude in the altitude limit. A value of zero disables the altitude limit.

params.name: AFS_RC
params.desc_en: This enables the RC part of the AFS. Will only be in effect if AFS_ENABLE is also 1

params.name: AFS_RC_FAIL_TIME
params.desc_en: This is the time in seconds in manual mode that failsafe termination will activate if RC input is lost. For the OBC rules this should be (1.5). Use 0 to disable.

params.name: AFS_RC_MAN_ONLY
params.display: Enable RC Termination only in manual control modes
params.desc_en: If this parameter is set to 1, then an RC loss will only cause the plane to terminate in manual control modes. If it is 0, then the plane will terminate in any flight mode.

params.name: AFS_TERMINATE
params.desc_en: Can be set in flight to force termination of the heartbeat signal

params.name: AFS_TERM_ACTION
params.desc_en: This can be used to force an action on flight termination. Normally this is handled by an external failsafe board, but you can setup ArduPilot to handle it here. Please consult the wiki for more information on the possible values of the parameter

params.name: AFS_TERM_PIN
params.desc_en: This sets a digital output pin to set high on flight termination. Some common values are given, but see the Wiki's "GPIOs" page for how to determine the pin number for a given autopilot.

params.name: AFS_WP_COMMS
params.desc_en: Waypoint number to navigate to on comms loss

params.name: AFS_WP_GPS_LOSS
params.desc_en: Waypoint number to navigate to on GPS lock loss

params.name: AHRS_COMP_BETA
params.display: AHRS Velocity Complementary Filter Beta Coefficient
params.desc_en: This controls the time constant for the cross-over frequency used to fuse AHRS (airspeed and heading) and GPS data to estimate ground velocity. Time constant is 0.1/beta. A larger time constant will use GPS data less and a small time constant will use air data less.

params.name: AHRS_CUSTOM_PIT
params.desc_en: Autopilot mounting position pitch offset. Positive values = pitch up, negative values = pitch down. This parameter is only used when AHRS_ORIENTATION is set to CUSTOM.

params.name: AHRS_CUSTOM_ROLL
params.desc_en: Autopilot mounting position roll offset. Positive values = roll right, negative values = roll left. This parameter is only used when AHRS_ORIENTATION is set to CUSTOM.

params.name: AHRS_CUSTOM_YAW
params.desc_en: Autopilot mounting position yaw offset. Positive values = yaw right, negative values = yaw left. This parameter is only used when AHRS_ORIENTATION is set to CUSTOM.

params.name: AHRS_EKF_TYPE
params.display: Use NavEKF Kalman filter for attitude and position estimation
params.desc_en: This controls which NavEKF Kalman filter version is used for attitude and position estimation

params.name: AHRS_GPS_GAIN
params.desc_en: This controls how much to use the GPS to correct the attitude. This should never be set to zero for a plane as it would result in the plane losing control in turns. For a plane please use the default value of 1.0.

params.name: AHRS_GPS_MINSATS
params.desc_en: Minimum number of satellites visible to use GPS for velocity based corrections attitude correction. This defaults to 6, which is about the point at which the velocity numbers from a GPS become too unreliable for accurate correction of the accelerometers.

params.name: AHRS_GPS_USE
params.display: AHRS use GPS for DCM navigation and position-down
params.desc_en: This controls whether to use dead-reckoning or GPS based navigation. If set to 0 then the GPS won't be used for navigation, and only dead reckoning will be used. A value of zero should never be used for normal flight. Currently this affects only the DCM-based AHRS: the EKF uses GPS according to its own parameters. A value of 2 means to use GPS for height as well as position - both in DCM estimation and when determining altitude-above-home.

values.en: Use GPS for DCM position and height

params.name: AHRS_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: This controls optional AHRS behaviour. Setting DisableDCMFallbackFW will change the AHRS behaviour for fixed wing aircraft in fly-forward flight to not fall back to DCM when the EKF stops navigating. Setting DisableDCMFallbackVTOL will change the AHRS behaviour for fixed wing aircraft in non fly-forward (VTOL) flight to not fall back to DCM when the EKF stops navigating. Setting DontDisableAirspeedUsingEKF disables the EKF based innovation check for airspeed consistency. Setting AutoRecordOrigin will auto-save the EKF origin to parameters when it becomes valid.

params.name: AHRS_ORIENTATION
params.desc_en: Overall board orientation relative to the standard orientation for the board type. This rotates the IMU and compass readings to allow the board to be oriented in your vehicle at any 90 or 45 degree angle. The label for each option is specified in the order of rotations for that orientation. This option takes affect on next boot. After changing you will need to re-level your vehicle. Firmware versions 4.2 and prior can use a CUSTOM (100) rotation to set the AHRS_CUSTOM_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles for AHRS orientation. Later versions provide two general custom rotations which can be used, Custom 1 and Custom 2, with CUST_ROT1_ROLL/PIT/YAW or CUST_ROT2_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles.

params.name: AHRS_ORIGIN_ALT
params.desc_en: AHRS last origin altitude in meters

params.name: AHRS_ORIGIN_LAT
params.desc_en: AHRS last origin latitude in degrees

params.name: AHRS_ORIGIN_LON
params.desc_en: AHRS last origin longitude in degrees

params.name: AHRS_ORIG_ALT
params.desc_en: AHRS/EKF origin will be set to this altitude (in meters above sea level) if not already set

params.name: AHRS_ORIG_LAT
params.desc_en: AHRS/EKF origin will be set to this latitude if not already set

params.name: AHRS_ORIG_LON
params.desc_en: AHRS/EKF origin will be set to this longitude if not already set

params.name: AHRS_RP_P
params.desc_en: This controls how fast the accelerometers correct the attitude

params.name: AHRS_TRIM_X
params.desc_en: Compensates for the roll angle difference between the control board and the frame. Positive values make the vehicle roll right.

params.name: AHRS_TRIM_Y
params.desc_en: Compensates for the pitch angle difference between the control board and the frame. Positive values make the vehicle pitch up/back.

params.name: AHRS_TRIM_Z
params.desc_en: Not Used

params.name: AHRS_WIND_MAX
params.desc_en: This sets the maximum allowable difference between ground speed and airspeed. A value of zero means to use the airspeed as is. This allows the plane to cope with a failing airspeed sensor by clipping it to groundspeed plus/minus this limit. See ARSPD_OPTIONS and ARSPD_WIND_MAX to disable airspeed sensors.

params.name: AHRS_YAW_P
params.desc_en: This controls the weight the compass or GPS has on the heading. A higher value means the heading will track the yaw source (GPS or compass) more rapidly.

params.name: AIS_LIST_MAX
params.desc_en: AIS list size of nearest vessels. Longer lists take longer to refresh with lower SRx_ADSB values.

params.name: AIS_LOGGING
params.desc_en: Bitmask of AIS logging options

params.name: AIS_TIME_OUT
params.desc_en: if no updates are received in this time a vessel will be removed from the list

params.name: AIS_TYPE
params.desc_en: AIS receiver type

params.name: ALAND_ENABLE
params.desc_en: enable Auto land script action

params.name: ALAND_WP_ALT
params.desc_en: Altitude of final approach waypoint created by script

params.name: ALAND_WP_DIST
params.desc_en: Distance from landing point (HOME) to final approach waypoint created by script in the opposite direction of initial takeoff

params.name: ARMING_ACCTHRESH
params.desc_en: Accelerometer error threshold used to determine inconsistent accelerometers. Compares this error range to other accelerometers to detect a hardware or calibration error. Lower value means tighter check and harder to pass arming check. Not all accelerometers are created equal.

params.name: ARMING_CRSDP_IGN
params.desc_en: Must have value "1" if crashdump data is present on the system, or a prearm failure will be raised. Do not set this parameter unless the risks of doing so are fully understood. The presence of a crash dump means that the firmware currently installed has suffered a critical software failure which resulted in the autopilot immediately rebooting. The crashdump file gives diagnostic information which can help in finding the issue, please contact the ArduPIlot support team. If this crashdump data is present, the vehicle is likely unsafe to fly. Check the ArduPilot documentation for more details.

params.name: ARMING_MAGTHRESH
params.display: Compass magnetic field strength error threshold vs earth magnetic model
params.desc_en: Compass magnetic field strength error threshold vs earth magnetic model. X and y axis are compared using this threhold, Z axis uses 2x this threshold. 0 to disable check

params.name: ARMING_MIS_ITEMS
params.desc_en: Bitmask of mission items that are required to be planned in order to arm the aircraft

params.name: ARMING_NEED_LOC
params.desc_en: Require that the vehicle have an absolute position before it arms. This can help ensure that the vehicle can Return To Launch.

params.name: ARMING_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: Options that can be applied to change arming behaviour

bitmask.en: Do not send status text on state change
Skip IMU consistency checks when ICE motor running

params.name: ARMING_RUDDER
params.desc_en: Allow arm/disarm by rudder input. When enabled arming can be done with right rudder, disarming with left rudder. Rudder arming only works with throttle at zero +- deadzone (RCx_DZ). Depending on vehicle type, arming in certain modes is prevented. See the wiki for each vehicle. Caution is recommended when arming if it is allowed in an auto-throttle mode!

params.name: ARMING_SKIPCHK
params.desc_en: Checks to skip prior to arming motor. This is a bitmask of checks before allowing arming that will be skipped. For most users it is recommended to leave this at the default of 0 (no checks skipped). In extreme circumstances, a value of -1 can be used to skip all non-mandatory current and future checks.

params.name: ARM_C_RTL_ALT_M
params.display: RTL_ALT_M should be a valid value
params.desc_en: RTL_ALT_M should be < 120m (400ft). 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_ESTOP
params.desc_en: Emergency Stop disables arming. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_FENCE
params.desc_en: Fences loaded but no fence enabled. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_FOLL_OFS_DEF
params.desc_en: Follow offsets should not be left as default (zero) if FOLL_ENABLE = 1. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_FOLL_SYSID
params.desc_en: If FOLL_ENABLE = 1, check that FOLL_SYSID has been set. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_FOLL_SYSID_X
params.desc_en: If FOLL_ENABLE = 1, check that FOLL_SYSID is different to MAV_SYSID. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_MNTX_SYSID
params.display: Follow and Mount should follow the same vehicle
params.desc_en: If FOLL_ENABLE = 1 and MNTx_SYSID_DEFLT is set, check that FOLL_SYSID is equal MNTx. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_P_AIRSPEED
params.desc_en: Validate that AIRSPEED_STALL(if set) < MIN < CRUISE < MAX d. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_P_QRTL_ALT
params.display: Q_RTL_ALT should be a valid value
params.desc_en: Q_RTL_ALT should be < 120m (400ft). 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_P_Q_FS_LAND
params.display: Warn if Q failsafe will land
params.desc_en: Notify the user that on failsafe a QuadPlan will land. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_P_Q_FS_RTL
params.display: Warn if Q failsafe will QRTL
params.desc_en: Notify the user that on failsafe a QuadPlan will QRTL. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_P_RTL_ALT
params.display: RTL_ALTITUDE should be a valid value
params.desc_en: RTL_ALTITITUDE should be < 120m (400ft). 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_P_SCALING
params.desc_en: Validate that SCALING_SPEED is within 20% of AIRSPEED_CRUISE. If SCALING_SPEED changes the vehicle may need to be retuned. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_P_STALL
params.desc_en: Validate that AIRSPEED_MIN is at least 25% above AIRSPEED_STALL(if set). 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_RALLY
params.desc_en: Rally Point more than RALLY_LIMIT_KM kilometers away. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_RTL_CLIMB
params.display: RTL_CLIMB_MIN should be a valid value
params.desc_en: RTL_CLIMB_MIN should be < 120m (400ft). 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_SYSID
params.desc_en: Check that MAV_SYSID (or SYDID_THISMAV) has been set. 3 or less to prevent arming. -1 to disable.

params.name: ARM_V_ALT_LEGAL
params.desc_en: Legal max altitude for UAV/RPAS/drones in your jurisdiction

params.name: AROT_COL_FILT_E
params.desc_en: Cut-off frequency for collective low pass filter. For the entry phase. Acts as a following trim. Must be higher than AROT_COL_FILT_G.

params.name: AROT_COL_FILT_G
params.desc_en: Cut-off frequency for collective low pass filter. For the glide phase. Acts as a following trim. Must be lower than AROT_COL_FILT_E.

params.name: AROT_ENABLE
params.desc_en: Allows you to enable (1) or disable (0) the autonomous autorotation capability.

params.name: AROT_FWD_D
params.desc_en: Provides damping to velocity controller.

params.name: AROT_FWD_FF
params.display: Forward Speed Controller Feed Forward Gain
params.desc_en: Produces an output that is proportional to the magnitude of the target.

params.name: AROT_FWD_FLTD
params.display: Forward Speed Controller input filter for D term
params.desc_en: This filter low pass filter is applied to the input for D terms.

params.name: AROT_FWD_FLTE
params.desc_en: This filter low pass filter is applied to the input for P and I terms.

params.name: AROT_FWD_I
params.desc_en: Corrects long-term difference in desired velocity to a target acceleration.

params.name: AROT_FWD_IMAX
params.display: Forward Speed Controller I Gain Maximum
params.desc_en: Constrains the target acceleration that the I gain will output.

params.name: AROT_FWD_P
params.desc_en: Converts the difference between desired forward speed and actual speed into an acceleration target that is passed to the pitch angle controller.

params.name: AROT_FWD_SP_TARG
params.display: Target Glide Body Frame Forward Speed
params.desc_en: Target ground speed in cm/s for the autorotation controller to try and achieve/ maintain during the glide phase.

params.name: AROT_HS_P
params.display: P gain for head speed controller
params.desc_en: Increase value to increase sensitivity of head speed controller during autonomous autorotation.

params.name: AROT_HS_SENSOR
params.desc_en: Allocate the RPM sensor instance to use for measuring head speed. RPM1 = 0. RPM2 = 1.

params.name: AROT_HS_SET_PT
params.desc_en: The target head speed in RPM during autorotation. Start by setting to desired hover speed and tune from there as necessary.

params.name: AROT_XY_ACC_MAX
params.desc_en: Maximum body frame acceleration allowed in the in speed controller. This limit defines a circular constraint in accel. Minimum used is 0.5 m/s/s.

params.name: ARSPD2_AUTOCAL
params.display: This parameter and function is not used by this vehicle. Always set to 0.
params.desc_en: Enables automatic adjustment of airspeed ratio during a calibration flight based on estimation of ground speed and true airspeed. New ratio saved every 2 minutes if change is > 5%. Should not be left enabled.

params.name: ARSPD2_BUS
params.desc_en: Bus number of the I2C bus where the airspeed sensor is connected. May not correspond to board's I2C bus number labels. Retry another bus and reboot if airspeed sensor fails to initialize.

params.name: ARSPD2_OFFSET
params.desc_en: Airspeed calibration offset

params.name: ARSPD2_PIN
params.desc_en: The pin number that the airspeed sensor is connected to for analog sensors. Values for some autopilots are given as examples. Search wiki for "Analog pins".

params.name: ARSPD2_PSI_RANGE
params.display: The PSI range of the device
params.desc_en: This parameter allows you to set the PSI (pounds per square inch) range for your sensor. You should not change this unless you examine the datasheet for your device

params.name: ARSPD2_RATIO
params.desc_en: Calibrates pitot tube pressure to velocity. Increasing this value will indicate a higher airspeed at any given dynamic pressure.

params.name: ARSPD2_SKIP_CAL
params.display: Skip airspeed offset calibration on startup
params.desc_en: This parameter allows you to skip airspeed offset calibration on startup, instead using the offset from the last calibration or requiring a manual calibration. This may be desirable if the offset variance between flights for your sensor is low and you want to avoid having to cover the pitot tube on each boot.

values.en: Do not require offset calibration before flight. Manual calibration should be performed during initial setup.
Do not calibrate on start up. Manual calibration must be performed once per boot.

params.name: ARSPD2_TUBE_ORDR
params.desc_en: This parameter allows you to control whether the order in which the tubes are attached to your pitot tube matters. If you set this to 0 then the first (often the top) connector on the sensor needs to be the stagnation pressure (the pressure at the tip of the pitot tube). If set to 1 then the second (often the bottom) connector needs to be the stagnation pressure. If set to 2 (the default) then the airspeed driver will accept either order. The reason you may wish to specify the order is it will allow your airspeed sensor to detect if the aircraft is receiving excessive pressure on the static port compared to the stagnation port such as during a stall, which would otherwise be seen as a positive airspeed.

params.name: ATC_THR_MIX_MAN
params.desc_en: Throttle vs attitude control prioritisation used during manual flight (higher values mean we prioritise attitude control over throttle)

params.name: ATC_THR_MIX_MAX
params.desc_en: Throttle vs attitude control prioritisation used during active flight (higher values mean we prioritise attitude control over throttle)

params.name: ATC_THR_MIX_MIN
params.desc_en: Throttle vs attitude control prioritisation used when landing (higher values mean we prioritise attitude control over throttle)

params.name: AUTOTUNE_ACC_MAX
params.desc_en: maximum angular acceleration in deg/s/s allowed during autotune maneuvers

params.name: AUTOTUNE_AGGR
params.desc_en: Autotune aggressiveness. Defines the bounce back used to detect size of the D term.

params.name: AUTOTUNE_AXES
params.desc_en: 1-byte bitmap of axes to autotune

params.name: AUTOTUNE_FRQ_MAX
params.desc_en: Defines the end frequency for sweeps and dwells

params.name: AUTOTUNE_FRQ_MIN
params.desc_en: Defines the start frequency for sweeps and dwells

params.name: AUTOTUNE_GMBK
params.desc_en: Fraction by which tuned P and D gains are reduced after rate and angle AutoTune steps complete. This provides extra stability margin by reducing gains slightly from the optimal values found during tuning. A value of 0.0 applies no reduction. A value of 0.25 reduces tuned gains by 25%.

params.name: AUTOTUNE_GN_MAX
params.desc_en: Defines the response gain (output/input) to tune

params.name: AUTOTUNE_MIN_D
params.desc_en: Defines the minimum D gain

params.name: AUTOTUNE_RAT_MAX
params.desc_en: maximum angular rate in deg/s allowed during autotune maneuvers

params.name: AUTOTUNE_SEQ
params.desc_en: 2-byte bitmask to select what tuning should be performed. Max gain automatically performed if Rate D is selected. Values: 7:All,1:VFF Only,2:Rate D/Rate P Only(incl max gain),4:Angle P Only,8:Max Gain Only,16:Tune Check,3:VFF and Rate D/Rate P(incl max gain),5:VFF and Angle P,6:Rate D/Rate P(incl max gain) and angle P

params.name: AUTOTUNE_VELXY_P
params.desc_en: Velocity xy P gain used to hold position during Max Gain, Rate P, and Rate D frequency sweeps

params.name: AUTO_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: A range of options that can be applied to change auto mode behaviour. Allow Arming allows the copter to be armed in Auto. Allow Takeoff Without Raising Throttle allows takeoff without the pilot having to raise the throttle. Ignore pilot yaw overrides the pilot's yaw stick being used while in auto.

params.name: AVD_ENABLE
params.desc_en: Enable Avoidance using ADSB

params.name: AVD_F_ACTION
params.desc_en: Specifies aircraft behaviour when a collision is imminent

params.name: AVD_F_ALT_MIN
params.desc_en: Minimum AMSL (above mean sea level) altitude for ADS-B avoidance. If the vehicle is below this altitude, no avoidance action will take place. Useful to prevent ADS-B avoidance from activating while below the tree line or around structures. Default of 0 is no minimum.

params.name: AVD_F_DIST_XY
params.desc_en: Closest allowed projected distance before F_ACTION is undertaken

params.name: AVD_F_DIST_Z
params.desc_en: Closest allowed projected distance before BEHAVIOUR_F is undertaken

params.name: AVD_F_RCVRY
params.display: Recovery behaviour after a fail event
params.desc_en: Determines what the aircraft will do after a fail event is resolved

params.name: AVD_F_TIME
params.desc_en: Aircraft velocity vectors are multiplied by this time to determine closest approach. If this results in an approach closer than F_DIST_XY or F_DIST_Z then F_ACTION is undertaken

params.name: AVD_OBS_MAX
params.display: Maximum number of obstacles to track
params.desc_en: Maximum number of obstacles to track

params.name: AVD_W_ACTION
params.desc_en: Specifies aircraft behaviour when a collision may occur

params.name: AVD_W_DIST_XY
params.desc_en: Closest allowed projected distance before W_ACTION is undertaken

params.name: AVD_W_DIST_Z
params.desc_en: Closest allowed projected distance before BEHAVIOUR_W is undertaken

params.name: AVD_W_TIME
params.desc_en: Aircraft velocity vectors are multiplied by this time to determine closest approach. If this results in an approach closer than W_DIST_XY or W_DIST_Z then W_ACTION is undertaken (assuming F_ACTION is not undertaken)

params.name: AVOID_ACCEL_MAX
params.desc_en: Maximum acceleration with which obstacles will be avoided with. Set zero to disable acceleration limits

params.name: AVOID_ALT_MIN
params.desc_en: Minimum altitude above which proximity based avoidance will start working. This requires a valid downward facing rangefinder reading to work. Set zero to disable

params.name: AVOID_ANG_MAX
params.display: Avoidance max lean angle in non-GPS flight modes
params.desc_en: Max lean angle used to avoid obstacles while in non-GPS modes. Set to zero to disable lean-based avoidance

params.name: AVOID_BACKUP_DZ
params.display: Avoidance deadzone between stopping and backing away from obstacle
params.desc_en: Distance beyond AVOID_MARGIN parameter, after which vehicle will backaway from obstacles. Increase this parameter if you see vehicle going back and forth in front of obstacle.

params.name: AVOID_BACKUP_SPD
params.desc_en: Maximum speed that will be used to back away from obstacles horizontally in position control modes (m/s). Set zero to disable horizontal backup.

params.name: AVOID_BACKZ_SPD
params.desc_en: Maximum speed that will be used to back away from obstacles vertically in height control modes (m/s). Set zero to disable vertical backup.

params.name: AVOID_BEHAVE
params.desc_en: Avoidance behaviour (slide or stop)

params.name: AVOID_DIST_MAX
params.display: Avoidance distance maximum in non-GPS flight modes
params.desc_en: Distance from object at which obstacle avoidance will begin in non-GPS modes

params.name: AVOID_ENABLE
params.desc_en: Enabled/disable avoidance input sources

params.name: AVOID_MARGIN
params.display: Avoidance distance margin in GPS modes
params.desc_en: Vehicle will attempt to stay at least this distance (in meters) from objects while in GPS modes

params.name: BARO1_DEVID
params.desc_en: Barometer sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

params.name: BARO1_GND_PRESS
params.desc_en: calibrated ground pressure in Pascals

params.name: BARO1_THST_SCALE
params.desc_en: Thrust scaling in Pascals. This value scaled by the normalized thrust is subtracted from the barometer pressure. This is used to adjust linearly based on the thrust output for local pressure difference induced by the props.

params.name: BARO1_WCF_BCK
params.display: Pressure error coefficient in negative X direction (backwards)
params.desc_en: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a negative wind relative velocity along the X body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during backwards flight, then this will be a negative number. Multirotors can use this feature only if using EKF3 and if the EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X and EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_Y parameters have been tuned.

params.name: BARO1_WCF_DN
params.display: Pressure error coefficient in negative Z direction (down)
params.desc_en: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a negative wind relative velocity along the Z body axis. If the baro height estimate rises above truth height during descending flight (or forward flight with a high backwards lean angle, eg braking manoeuvre), then this should be a negative number. Multirotors can use this feature only if using EKF3 and if the EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X and EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_Y parameters have been tuned.

params.name: BARO1_WCF_ENABLE
params.desc_en: This enables the use of wind coefficients for barometer compensation

params.name: BARO1_WCF_FWD
params.display: Pressure error coefficient in positive X direction (forward)
params.desc_en: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a positive wind relative velocity along the X body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during forwards flight, then this will be a negative number. Multirotors can use this feature only if using EKF3 and if the EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X and EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_Y parameters have been tuned.

params.name: BARO1_WCF_LFT
params.display: Pressure error coefficient in negative Y direction (left)
params.desc_en: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a negative wind relative velocity along the Y body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during sideways flight to the left, then this should be a negative number. Multirotors can use this feature only if using EKF3 and if the EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X and EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_Y parameters have been tuned.

params.name: BARO1_WCF_RGT
params.display: Pressure error coefficient in positive Y direction (right)
params.desc_en: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a positive wind relative velocity along the Y body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during sideways flight to the right, then this should be a negative number. Multirotors can use this feature only if using EKF3 and if the EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X and EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_Y parameters have been tuned.

params.name: BARO1_WCF_UP
params.display: Pressure error coefficient in positive Z direction (up)
params.desc_en: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a positive wind relative velocity along the Z body axis. If the baro height estimate rises above truth height during climbing flight (or forward flight with a high forwards lean angle), then this should be a negative number. Multirotors can use this feature only if using EKF3 and if the EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X and EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_Y parameters have been tuned.

params.desc_en: Barometer2 sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

params.name: BARO2_GND_PRESS
params.desc_en: calibrated ground pressure in Pascals

params.name: BARO_ALTERR_MAX
params.desc_en: This is the maximum acceptable altitude discrepancy between GPS altitude and barometric presssure altitude calculated against a standard atmosphere for arming checks to pass. If you are getting an arming error due to this parameter then you may have a faulty or substituted barometer. A common issue is vendors replacing a MS5611 in a "Pixhawk" with a MS5607. If you have that issue then please see BARO_OPTIONS parameter to force the MS5611 to be treated as a MS5607. This check is disabled if the value is zero.

params.name: BARO_ALT_OFFSET
params.desc_en: altitude offset in meters added to barometric altitude. This is used to allow for automatic adjustment of the base barometric altitude by a ground station equipped with a barometer. The value is added to the barometric altitude read by the aircraft. It is automatically reset to 0 when the barometer is calibrated on each reboot or when a preflight calibration is performed.

params.name: BARO_EXT_BUS
params.desc_en: This selects the bus number for looking for an I2C barometer. When set to -1 it will probe all external i2c buses based on the BARO_PROBE_EXT parameter.

params.name: BARO_FIELD_ELV
params.desc_en: User provided field elevation in meters. This is used to improve the calculation of the altitude the vehicle is at. This parameter is not persistent and will be reset to 0 every time the vehicle is rebooted. Changes to this parameter will only be used when disarmed. A value of 0 means the EKF origin height is used for takeoff height above sea level.

params.name: BARO_FLTR_RNG
params.display: Range in which sample is accepted
params.desc_en: This sets the range around the average value that new samples must be within to be accepted. This can help reduce the impact of noise on sensors that are on long I2C cables. The value is a percentage from the average value. A value of zero disables this filter.

params.name: BARO_GND_TEMP
params.desc_en: User provided ambient ground temperature in degrees Celsius. This is used to improve the calculation of the altitude the vehicle is at. This parameter is not persistent and will be reset to 0 every time the vehicle is rebooted. A value of 0 means use the internal measurement ambient temperature.

params.name: BARO_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: Barometer options

params.name: BARO_PRIMARY
params.desc_en: This selects which barometer will be the primary if multiple barometers are found

params.name: BARO_PROBE_EXT
params.desc_en: This sets which types of external i2c barometer to look for. It is a bitmask of barometer types. The I2C buses to probe is based on BARO_EXT_BUS. If BARO_EXT_BUS is -1 then it will probe all external buses, otherwise it will probe just the bus number given in BARO_EXT_BUS.

params.name: BATT2_AMP_OFFSET
params.desc_en: Voltage offset at zero current on current sensor

params.name: BATT2_AMP_PERVLT
params.desc_en: Number of amps that a 1V reading on the current sensor corresponds to.

params.name: BATT2_ARM_MAH
params.desc_en: Battery capacity remaining which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any capacity. Note that execept for smart batteries rebooting the vehicle will always reset the remaining capacity estimate, which can lead to this check not providing sufficent protection, it is recommended to always use this in conjunction with the BATT2_ARM_VOLT parameter.

params.name: BATT2_ARM_VOLT
params.desc_en: Battery voltage level which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any voltage.

params.name: BATT2_CAPACITY
params.desc_en: Capacity of the battery in mAh when full

params.name: BATT2_CHANNEL
params.desc_en: INA3221 channel to return data for

params.name: BATT2_CRT_MAH
params.desc_en: Battery capacity at which the critical battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT2_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATT2_CRT_VOLT
params.desc_en: Battery voltage that triggers a critical battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT2_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT2_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATT2_CURR_MULT
params.desc_en: Multiplier applied to all current related reports to allow for adjustment if no UAVCAN param access or current splitting applications

params.name: BATT2_CURR_PIN
params.desc_en: Sets the analog input pin that should be used for Current monitoring on AD7091R5.

params.name: BATT2_ESC_INDEX
params.display: ESC Telemetry Index to write to
params.desc_en: ESC Telemetry Index to write voltage, current, consumption and temperature data to. Use 0 to disable.

params.name: BATT2_ESC_MASK
params.desc_en: If 0 all connected ESCs will be used. If non-zero, only those selected in will be used.

params.name: BATT2_FL_FF
params.desc_en: First order polynomial fit term

params.name: BATT2_FL_FLTR
params.desc_en: Filter frequency in Hertz where a low pass filter is used. This is used to filter out tank slosh from the fuel level reading. A value of -1 disables the filter and unfiltered voltage is used to determine the fuel level. The suggested values at in the range of 0.2 Hz to 0.5 Hz.

params.name: BATT2_FL_FS
params.desc_en: Second order polynomial fit term

params.name: BATT2_FL_FT
params.desc_en: Third order polynomial fit term

params.name: BATT2_FL_OFF
params.desc_en: Offset polynomial fit term

params.name: BATT2_FL_PIN
params.desc_en: Analog input pin that fuel level sensor is connected to.Analog Airspeed or RSSI ports can be used for Analog input( some autopilots provide others also). Values for some autopilots are given as examples. Search wiki for "Analog pins".

params.name: BATT2_FL_VLT_MIN
params.desc_en: The voltage seen on the analog pin when the fuel tank is empty. Note: For this type of battery monitor, the voltage seen by the analog pin is displayed as battery voltage on a GCS.

params.name: BATT2_FL_V_MULT
params.desc_en: Voltage multiplier to determine what the full tank voltage reading is. This is calculated as 1 / (Voltage_Full - Voltage_Empty) Note: For this type of battery monitor, the voltage seen by the analog pin is displayed as battery voltage on a GCS.

params.name: BATT2_FS_CRT_ACT
params.desc_en: What action the vehicle should perform if it hits a critical battery failsafe

params.name: BATT2_FS_LOW_ACT
params.desc_en: What action the vehicle should perform if it hits a low battery failsafe

params.name: BATT2_FS_VOLTSRC
params.desc_en: Voltage type used for detection of low voltage event

params.name: BATT2_I2C_ADDR
params.desc_en: Battery monitor I2C address. If this is zero then probe list of supported addresses

params.name: BATT2_I2C_BUS
params.desc_en: Battery monitor I2C bus number

params.name: BATT2_LOW_MAH
params.desc_en: Battery capacity at which the low battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT2_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATT2_LOW_TIMER
params.desc_en: This is the timeout in seconds before a low voltage event will be triggered. For aircraft with low C batteries it may be necessary to raise this in order to cope with low voltage on long takeoffs. A value of zero disables low voltage errors.

params.name: BATT2_LOW_VOLT
params.desc_en: Battery voltage that triggers a low battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT2_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT2_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATT2_MAX_AMPS
params.desc_en: This controls the maximum current the INA239 sensor will work with.

params.name: BATT2_MAX_VOLT
params.desc_en: Maximum voltage of battery. Provides scaling of current versus voltage

params.name: BATT2_MONITOR
params.desc_en: Controls enabling monitoring of the battery's voltage and current

params.name: BATT2_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: This sets options to change the behaviour of the battery monitor

bitmask.en: MPPT reports input voltage and current
Send resistance compensated voltage to GCS
Allow DroneCAN InfoAux to be from a different CAN node
Battery is for internal autopilot use only
Sum monitor measures minimum voltage instead of average
Allow DroneCAN dynamic node update on hot-swap

params.name: BATT2_SERIAL_NUM
params.desc_en: Battery serial number, automatically filled in for SMBus batteries, otherwise will be -1. With DroneCan it is the battery_id.

params.name: BATT2_SHUNT
params.desc_en: This sets the shunt resistor used in the device

params.name: BATT2_SUM_MASK
params.desc_en: 0: sum of remaining battery monitors, If none 0 sum of specified monitors. Current will be summed and voltages averaged.

params.name: BATT2_VLT_OFFSET
params.desc_en: Voltage offset on voltage pin. This allows for an offset due to a diode. This voltage is subtracted before the scaling is applied

params.name: BATT2_VOLT_MULT
params.desc_en: Used to convert the voltage of the voltage sensing pin (BATT2_VOLT_PIN) to the actual battery's voltage (pin_voltage * VOLT_MULT).

params.name: BATT2_VOLT_PIN
params.display: Battery Voltage sensing pin on the AD7091R5 Ic
params.desc_en: Sets the analog input pin that should be used for voltage monitoring on AD7091R5.

params.name: BATT3_AMP_OFFSET
params.desc_en: Voltage offset at zero current on current sensor

params.name: BATT3_AMP_PERVLT
params.desc_en: Number of amps that a 1V reading on the current sensor corresponds to.

params.name: BATT7_I2C_BUS
params.desc_en: Battery monitor I2C bus number

params.name: BATT7_LOW_MAH
params.desc_en: Battery capacity at which the low battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT7_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATT7_LOW_TIMER
params.desc_en: This is the timeout in seconds before a low voltage event will be triggered. For aircraft with low C batteries it may be necessary to raise this in order to cope with low voltage on long takeoffs. A value of zero disables low voltage errors.

params.name: BATT7_LOW_VOLT
params.desc_en: Battery voltage that triggers a low battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT7_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT7_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATT7_MAX_AMPS
params.desc_en: This controls the maximum current the INA239 sensor will work with.

params.name: BATT7_MAX_VOLT
params.desc_en: Maximum voltage of battery. Provides scaling of current versus voltage

params.name: BATT7_MONITOR
params.desc_en: Controls enabling monitoring of the battery's voltage and current

params.name: BATT7_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: This sets options to change the behaviour of the battery monitor

bitmask.en: MPPT reports input voltage and current
Send resistance compensated voltage to GCS
Allow DroneCAN InfoAux to be from a different CAN node
Battery is for internal autopilot use only
Sum monitor measures minimum voltage instead of average
Allow DroneCAN dynamic node update on hot-swap

params.name: BATT7_SERIAL_NUM
params.desc_en: Battery serial number, automatically filled in for SMBus batteries, otherwise will be -1. With DroneCan it is the battery_id.

params.name: BATT7_SHUNT
params.desc_en: This sets the shunt resistor used in the device

params.name: BATT7_SUM_MASK
params.desc_en: 0: sum of remaining battery monitors, If none 0 sum of specified monitors. Current will be summed and voltages averaged.

params.name: BATT7_VLT_OFFSET
params.desc_en: Voltage offset on voltage pin. This allows for an offset due to a diode. This voltage is subtracted before the scaling is applied

params.name: BATT7_VOLT_MULT
params.desc_en: Used to convert the voltage of the voltage sensing pin (BATT7_VOLT_PIN) to the actual battery's voltage (pin_voltage * VOLT_MULT).

params.name: BATT7_VOLT_PIN
params.display: Battery Voltage sensing pin on the AD7091R5 Ic
params.desc_en: Sets the analog input pin that should be used for voltage monitoring on AD7091R5.

params.name: BATT8_AMP_OFFSET
params.desc_en: Voltage offset at zero current on current sensor

params.name: BATT8_AMP_PERVLT
params.desc_en: Number of amps that a 1V reading on the current sensor corresponds to.

params.name: BATT8_ARM_MAH
params.desc_en: Battery capacity remaining which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any capacity. Note that execept for smart batteries rebooting the vehicle will always reset the remaining capacity estimate, which can lead to this check not providing sufficent protection, it is recommended to always use this in conjunction with the BATT8_ARM_VOLT parameter.

params.name: BATT8_ARM_VOLT
params.desc_en: Battery voltage level which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any voltage.

params.name: BATT8_CAPACITY
params.desc_en: Capacity of the battery in mAh when full

params.name: BATT8_CHANNEL
params.desc_en: INA3221 channel to return data for

params.name: BATT8_CRT_MAH
params.desc_en: Battery capacity at which the critical battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT8_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATT8_CURR_PIN
params.desc_en: Sets the analog input pin that should be used for Current monitoring on AD7091R5.

params.name: BATT8_ESC_INDEX
params.display: ESC Telemetry Index to write to
params.desc_en: ESC Telemetry Index to write voltage, current, consumption and temperature data to. Use 0 to disable.

params.name: BATT8_ESC_MASK
params.desc_en: If 0 all connected ESCs will be used. If non-zero, only those selected in will be used.

params.name: BATT8_FL_FF
params.desc_en: First order polynomial fit term

params.name: BATT8_FL_FLTR
params.desc_en: Filter frequency in Hertz where a low pass filter is used. This is used to filter out tank slosh from the fuel level reading. A value of -1 disables the filter and unfiltered voltage is used to determine the fuel level. The suggested values at in the range of 0.2 Hz to 0.5 Hz.

params.name: BATT8_FL_FS
params.desc_en: Second order polynomial fit term

params.name: BATT8_FL_FT
params.desc_en: Third order polynomial fit term

params.name: BATT8_FL_OFF
params.desc_en: Offset polynomial fit term

params.name: BATT8_FL_PIN
params.desc_en: Analog input pin that fuel level sensor is connected to.Analog Airspeed or RSSI ports can be used for Analog input( some autopilots provide others also). Values for some autopilots are given as examples. Search wiki for "Analog pins".

params.name: BATT8_FL_VLT_MIN
params.desc_en: The voltage seen on the analog pin when the fuel tank is empty. Note: For this type of battery monitor, the voltage seen by the analog pin is displayed as battery voltage on a GCS.

params.name: BATT8_FL_V_MULT
params.desc_en: Voltage multiplier to determine what the full tank voltage reading is. This is calculated as 1 / (Voltage_Full - Voltage_Empty) Note: For this type of battery monitor, the voltage seen by the analog pin is displayed as battery voltage on a GCS.

Allow DroneCAN InfoAux to be from a different CAN node
Battery is for internal autopilot use only
Sum monitor measures minimum voltage instead of average
Allow DroneCAN dynamic node update on hot-swap

params.name: BATTB_SERIAL_NUM
params.desc_en: Battery serial number, automatically filled in for SMBus batteries, otherwise will be -1. With DroneCan it is the battery_id.

params.name: BATTB_SHUNT
params.desc_en: This sets the shunt resistor used in the device

params.name: BATTB_SUM_MASK
params.desc_en: 0: sum of remaining battery monitors, If none 0 sum of specified monitors. Current will be summed and voltages averaged.

params.name: BATTB_VLT_OFFSET
params.desc_en: Voltage offset on voltage pin. This allows for an offset due to a diode. This voltage is subtracted before the scaling is applied

params.name: BATTB_VOLT_MULT
params.desc_en: Used to convert the voltage of the voltage sensing pin (BATTB_VOLT_PIN) to the actual battery's voltage (pin_voltage * VOLT_MULT).

params.name: BATTB_VOLT_PIN
params.display: Battery Voltage sensing pin on the AD7091R5 Ic
params.desc_en: Sets the analog input pin that should be used for voltage monitoring on AD7091R5.

params.name: BATTC_AMP_OFFSET
params.desc_en: Voltage offset at zero current on current sensor

params.name: BATTC_AMP_PERVLT
params.desc_en: Number of amps that a 1V reading on the current sensor corresponds to.

params.name: BATTC_ARM_MAH
params.desc_en: Battery capacity remaining which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any capacity. Note that execept for smart batteries rebooting the vehicle will always reset the remaining capacity estimate, which can lead to this check not providing sufficent protection, it is recommended to always use this in conjunction with the BATTC_ARM_VOLT parameter.

params.name: BATTC_ARM_VOLT
params.desc_en: Battery voltage level which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any voltage.

params.name: BATTC_CAPACITY
params.desc_en: Capacity of the battery in mAh when full

params.name: BATTC_CHANNEL
params.desc_en: INA3221 channel to return data for

params.name: BATTC_CRT_MAH
params.desc_en: Battery capacity at which the critical battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATTC_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATTC_CRT_VOLT
params.desc_en: Battery voltage that triggers a critical battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATTC_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATTC_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATTC_CURR_MULT
params.desc_en: Multiplier applied to all current related reports to allow for adjustment if no UAVCAN param access or current splitting applications

params.name: BATTC_CURR_PIN
params.desc_en: Sets the analog input pin that should be used for Current monitoring on AD7091R5.

params.name: BATTC_ESC_INDEX
params.display: ESC Telemetry Index to write to
params.desc_en: ESC Telemetry Index to write voltage, current, consumption and temperature data to. Use 0 to disable.

params.name: BATTC_ESC_MASK
params.desc_en: If 0 all connected ESCs will be used. If non-zero, only those selected in will be used.

params.name: BATTC_FL_FF
params.desc_en: First order polynomial fit term

params.name: BATTC_FL_FLTR
params.desc_en: Filter frequency in Hertz where a low pass filter is used. This is used to filter out tank slosh from the fuel level reading. A value of -1 disables the filter and unfiltered voltage is used to determine the fuel level. The suggested values at in the range of 0.2 Hz to 0.5 Hz.

params.name: BATTC_FL_FS
params.desc_en: Second order polynomial fit term

params.name: BATTC_FL_FT
params.desc_en: Third order polynomial fit term

params.name: BATTC_FL_OFF
params.desc_en: Offset polynomial fit term

params.name: BATTC_FL_PIN
params.desc_en: Analog input pin that fuel level sensor is connected to.Analog Airspeed or RSSI ports can be used for Analog input( some autopilots provide others also). Values for some autopilots are given as examples. Search wiki for "Analog pins".

params.name: BATTC_FL_VLT_MIN
params.desc_en: The voltage seen on the analog pin when the fuel tank is empty. Note: For this type of battery monitor, the voltage seen by the analog pin is displayed as battery voltage on a GCS.

params.name: BATTC_FL_V_MULT
params.desc_en: Voltage multiplier to determine what the full tank voltage reading is. This is calculated as 1 / (Voltage_Full - Voltage_Empty) Note: For this type of battery monitor, the voltage seen by the analog pin is displayed as battery voltage on a GCS.

params.name: BATTC_FS_CRT_ACT
params.desc_en: What action the vehicle should perform if it hits a critical battery failsafe

params.name: BATTC_FS_LOW_ACT
params.desc_en: What action the vehicle should perform if it hits a low battery failsafe

params.name: BATTC_FS_VOLTSRC
params.desc_en: Voltage type used for detection of low voltage event

params.name: BATTC_I2C_ADDR
params.desc_en: Battery monitor I2C address. If this is zero then probe list of supported addresses

params.name: BATTC_I2C_BUS
params.desc_en: Battery monitor I2C bus number

params.name: BATTC_LOW_MAH
params.desc_en: Battery capacity at which the low battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATTC_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATTC_LOW_TIMER
params.desc_en: This is the timeout in seconds before a low voltage event will be triggered. For aircraft with low C batteries it may be necessary to raise this in order to cope with low voltage on long takeoffs. A value of zero disables low voltage errors.

params.name: BATTC_LOW_VOLT
params.desc_en: Battery voltage that triggers a low battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATTC_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATTC_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

params.name: BATTC_MAX_AMPS
params.desc_en: This controls the maximum current the INA239 sensor will work with.

params.name: BATTC_MAX_VOLT
params.desc_en: Maximum voltage of battery. Provides scaling of current versus voltage

params.name: BATTC_MONITOR
params.desc_en: Controls enabling monitoring of the battery's voltage and current

params.name: BATTC_OPTIONS
params.desc_en: This sets options to change the behaviour of the battery monitor

Using 5V output can help to reduce the impact of ESC noise interference corrupting signals to the ESCs.

If the amplitude of the control action produced by the rate feedback exceeds this value, then the D+P gain is reduced to respect the limit. This limits the amplitude of high frequency oscillations caused by an excessive gain. The limit should be set to no more than 25% of the actuators maximum slew rate to allow for load effects. Note: The gain will not be reduced to less than 10% of the nominal value. A value of zero will disable this feature.

params.name: COMPASS_LEARN

If this option is enabled then the learnt offsets are saved when you disarm the vehicle. If InFlight learning is enabled then the compass with automatically start learning once a flight starts (must be armed). While InFlight learning is running you cannot use position control modes.

params.name: COMPASS_ORIENT
params.desc_en: The orientation of the first external compass relative to the vehicle frame. This value will be ignored unless this compass is set as an external compass. When set correctly in the northern hemisphere, pointing the nose and right side down should increase the MagX and MagY values respectively. Rolling the vehicle upside down should decrease the MagZ value. For southern hemisphere, switch increase and decrease. NOTE: For internal compasses, AHRS_ORIENT is used. The label for each option is specified in the order of rotations for that orientation. Firmware versions 4.2 and prior can use a CUSTOM (100) rotation to set the COMPASS_CUS_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles for Compass orientation. Later versions provide two general custom rotations which can be used, Custom 1 and Custom 2, with CUST_1_ROLL/PIT/YAW or CUST_2_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles.

params.name: COMPASS_ORIENT2
params.desc_en: The orientation of a second external compass relative to the vehicle frame. This value will be ignored unless this compass is set as an external compass. When set correctly in the northern hemisphere, pointing the nose and right side down should increase the MagX and MagY values respectively. Rolling the vehicle upside down should decrease the MagZ value. For southern hemisphere, switch increase and decrease. NOTE: For internal compasses, AHRS_ORIENT is used. The label for each option is specified in the order of rotations for that orientation. Firmware versions 4.2 and prior can use a CUSTOM (100) rotation to set the COMPASS_CUS_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles for Compass orientation. Later versions provide two general custom rotations which can be used, Custom 1 and Custom 2, with CUST_1_ROLL/PIT/YAW or CUST_2_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles.

params.name: COMPASS_ORIENT3
params.desc_en: The orientation of a third external compass relative to the vehicle frame. This value will be ignored unless this compass is set as an external compass. When set correctly in the northern hemisphere, pointing the nose and right side down should increase the MagX and MagY values respectively. Rolling the vehicle upside down should decrease the MagZ value. For southern hemisphere, switch increase and decrease. NOTE: For internal compasses, AHRS_ORIENT is used. The label for each option is specified in the order of rotations for that orientation. Firmware versions 4.2 and prior can use a CUSTOM (100) rotation to set the COMPASS_CUS_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles for Compass orientation. Later versions provide two general custom rotations which can be used, Custom 1 and Custom 2, with CUST_1_ROLL/PIT/YAW or CUST_2_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles.

params.name: DIST_CUTOFF

params.name: DR_FLY_ALT_MIN

params.name: DR_FLY_ANGLE

params.name: DR_FLY_TIMEOUT
params.desc_en: Copter will attempt to switch to NEXT_MODE after this many seconds of deadreckoning. If it cannot switch modes it will continue in Guided_NoGPS. Set to 0 to disable timeout

params.name: DR_GPS_SACC_MAX
params.display: Deadreckoning GPS speed accuracy maximum threshold
params.desc_en: GPS speed accuracy maximum, above which deadreckoning home will begin (default is 0.8). Lower values trigger with good GPS quality, higher values will allow poorer GPS before triggering. Set to 0 to disable use of GPS speed accuracy

params.name: DR_GPS_SAT_MIN
params.display: Deadreckoning GPS satellite count min threshold
params.desc_en: GPS satellite count threshold below which deadreckoning home will begin (default is 6). Higher values trigger with good GPS quality, Lower values trigger with worse GPS quality. Set to 0 to disable use of GPS satellite count

params.name: DR_GPS_TRIGG_SEC
params.desc_en: GPS checks must fail for this many seconds before dead reckoning will be triggered

params.name: DR_NEXT_MODE
params.desc_en: Copter switch to this mode after GPS recovers or DR_FLY_TIMEOUT has elapsed. Default is 6/RTL. Set to -1 to return to mode used before deadreckoning was triggered

params.name: EFI_COEF2
